about: How tools/make_relief.py lifts the Monaco board into a 3D model. Hand-written; the profile it reads is fetched by `make_relief.py fetch`.

circuit.range_source: Casino (T4) to just before La Rascasse, as formula1.com and most circuit guides give it

anchors_note: Each board sector's middle, as metres along the real lap (from the GeoJSON's first point, at the Casino). s6 is Portier, where the board's long right-hand run turns along the shore.

bridge.why: Mirabeau Bas and Portier read buildings as a rise and then a cliff, though the road falls steadily from the hairpin to the tunnel; the tunnel reads the hill and hotel over it, its exit the harbour beside it, and the quay on to Tabac the buildings along it; the road just eases down to the waterfront
Sainte Devote sits in a ravine under a bridge, which the grid reads as a 30 m crest; the road climbs steadily from the pit straight up Beau Rivage
Rascasse and Noghes: the cliff behind the quay bleeds into a 25 m grid
the pit straight: the GeoJSON line strays onto the harbour (0 m) and the hillside
